name: Community Healthcare Trust Incorporated Common Stock, $0.01 par value per share
description: Community Healthcare Trust Inc is an integrated healthcare real estate company in the United States. The company owns and acquires, or finances, real estate properties that are leased to hospitals, doctors, healthcare systems, or other healthcare service providers in non-urban markets. The company derives the majority of its revenues from its real estate property and mortgage notes portfolio. The company's rental and mortgage interest income is recognized based on contractual arrangements with its tenants and borrowers.
